explanation: The unit fires almost only at D2, and it peaks (9-10) when the agent chose a1 but landed in S2 by a rare transition; reaching S2 after choosing a2 usually gives 2-4, rising to 6-9 just after the agent has switched to a2 or when the previous trial went unrewarded. Reaching S1 gives 1-4 after a1 (common) and 0-1 after a2 (rare); D1 and GO are always 0-1, sitting at 1 instead of 0 mainly in later trials (about 55+) while the agent keeps picking a1 after unrewarded trials.
